Cross-chain notifications and communication between blockchains.     Web3 marketing campaigns (MailtoEarn allows earning points). However, due to its Web3 focus and some data collection (IP, device info), it’s less suited for absolute anonymity compared to services like Proton Mail. It’s a tool for those seeking to combine security, innovation, and functionality in the decentralized world.
